about: Synthetic input for computeSignals(user, now, pack) and decidePush(signals, ctx, now, pack) with the proposed pack values in ../research.md section 7. 'expected.signals' is the full ordered output; 'expected.today' the rows Today shows; 'expected.push' the decision (causeKey null = no push, with the reason). 'selected: false' means the monitor skips the user. Times are UTC ISO; local dates and the window use user.timeZone.

cases.description: Bogota 08:05, weather is a known trigger. Forecast falls 6.5 hPa from 13:00Z today to 13:00Z tomorrow (same hour, so the daily tide cancels). Signal and push.
Same user, the forecast falls 5.4 hPa: under the 6 hPa threshold, no signal.
Weather is a trigger but the user declined location: no forecast is fetched and no pressure signal exists (never a guess).
Weather is not in the onboarding triggers but was tagged on 3 attacks in 90 days, which qualifies. The cached forecast is 4 h old (over the 3 h limit), so the signal is skipped this run.
5 attack nights in 90 days average 5.1 h (band midpoints), other nights 7.5 h. Today's check-in says under 5 h (4.5): under the attack-night average. Signal and push.
Same as S01 at 06:30 local, before the 08:00 window: the signal exists for Today, no push.
15:05 local, two pushes already sent today (local day) for other causes, cap 2: no third push.
A pressure push went out yesterday at 10:05 local (22 h ago). Today's pressure signal is a new cause key but the same cause: no push until 24 h have passed. It still shows on Today.
Triptan on 10 local days this month (limit). That exact key was pushed 3 days ago, so it is skipped for good; the debrief for yesterday's attack is pushed instead.
An attack open for 15 h. Long attack is signalled at the 12 h stage; pressure and quiet-tracker are suppressed while an attack is open.
Last check-in on Nov 23; none on Nov 24, 25, 26 or today. One signal per quiet stretch (the key carries the last check-in date).
Onboarded 2 days ago with no check-ins yet: too new to be quiet. Nothing.
Santiago in November is on DST (UTC-3). 04:30Z is 01:30 local, inside a 22:00-07:00 window that crosses midnight. The attack ended at 21:00 local yesterday (Nov 26): debrief due, pushed.
The user set notifications to zero a day. The debrief signal shows on Today; no push ever.
profiles.timezone is null (never synced or rejected by validation). The monitor cannot place the user's window, so it skips the user.

Triptan on 5 days and ibuprofen on 4 other days in November: neither class is near its own limit, but 9 combined days of 10 is a warning (ICHD-3 8.2.7). A dose at 23:50 local on Oct 31 (Nov 1 in UTC) counts for October, not November.
Four signals at once. Today shows the first three by priority; the push takes the first one.
